# reelplanner

> Review a coding agent's implementation plan as a short narrated video that stops at each open choice. The answers are recorded in a decision log in the repo, and after the build a walkthrough video shows the choices the agent made on its own. An agent skill (plan-to-video) plus a CLI (`reelplanner`, `reel`). Tested with Claude Code, basic support for Codex. Not on npm yet: install with `npm i -g github:ncrispino/reelplanner`, then `reelplanner setup`, then `npx skills add "$(npm root -g)/reelplanner" --skill plan-to-video -g`.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what it does, install, quick-start examples (new project, existing repo), the three ways to use it, the voice, how it compares
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): exact steps for an agent, to use reelplanner in another repo or to contribute here
- [The skill](skills/plan-to-video/SKILL.md): what the agent does, step by step, and every command it runs
- [Agents](docs/agents.md): support per agent (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI) and open work
